instructions.zh: 将射手扔进玻璃里。装满啤酒
instructions.en: Drop shooter in glass. Fill with beer

instructions.zh: 混合所有成分。搅拌直至光滑。如果需要，可以用巧克力屑装饰。
instructions.en: Combine all ingredients. Blend until smooth. Garnish with chocolate shavings if desired.

instructions.zh: 与冰混合。盛入酒杯中。用胡萝卜装饰。
instructions.en: Blend with ice. Serve in a wine glass. Garnish with carrot.

instructions.zh: 添加冰块，摇匀并倒入。
instructions.en: Add over ice,shake and pour.

instructions.zh: 将两种成分添加到酒杯中，射击，然后很快喝醉
instructions.en: Add both ingredients to shot glass, shoot, and get drunk quick

instructions.zh: 把它们放进玻璃杯里……然后把它砸到你的头上。
instructions.en: put them them in a glass... and slam it to tha head.

instructions.zh: 在 14 盎司玻璃杯中加入冰块和酒精。将 2/3 杯装满可乐，剩余的装满糖醋。上面撒上少许苦味剂和柠檬角。
instructions.en: Fill 14oz glass with ice and alcohol. Fill 2/3 glass with cola and remainder with sweet & sour. Top with dash of bitters and lemon wedge.

instructions.zh: 混合在一起享受吧！
instructions.en: Mix together and enjoy!

instructions.zh: 用碎冰填充玻璃杯。添加伏特加。添加一点金万利酒。填充 o.j.
instructions.en: fill glass with crushed ice. Add vodka. Add a splash of grand-marnier. Fill with o.j.

instructions.zh: 将等量的物质混合到装有冰的玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: Mix equal amounts into a glass with ice.

recipes.name: 57 Chevy with a White License Plate

instructions.zh: 1. 在岩石杯中加入冰块 2. 添加白可可奶油和伏特加 3. 搅拌
instructions.en: 1. Fill a rocks glass with ice 2.add white creme de cacao and vodka 3.stir

instructions.zh: 倒入 2 盎司。杜松子酒。添加 4 盎司。 7 向上。添加柠檬汁调味。如果你很弱，可以用更多的 7-Up 来补充玻璃杯。
instructions.en: Pour 2 oz. gin. Add 4 oz. 7-up. Add Lemon Juice for flavor. If you are weak, top up glass with more 7-Up.

instructions.zh: 倒入卡鲁哈，然后是百利甜酒，然后是弗朗格利科，不要冷藏，不要分层——上菜！
instructions.en: pour kaluha, then Baileys, then Frangelico not chilled and not layered -- SERVE!!!

instructions.zh:
将柯林斯杯装满冰块。
倒入伏特加、酸橙甜酒和酸果蔓汁。
用雪碧填充。
用青柠轮或一些蔓越莓装饰
instructions.en:
Fill a Collins glass with ice.
Pour in vodka, lime cordial, and cranberry juice.
Fill up with Sprite.
Garnish with a Lime wheel or some cranberries

instructions.zh: 将所有成分混合在玻璃搅拌器中。冷却并滤入鸡尾酒杯。用切片草莓装饰。
instructions.en: Combine all ingredients in glass mixer. Chill and strain into Cocktail glass. Garnish with sliced strawberry.

instructions.zh: 加冰摇匀原料，滤入鸡尾酒杯即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入鸡尾酒调酒器中，混合并加冰倒入冰镇的玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, mix and serve over ice into a chilled glass.

instructions.zh: 分层放入小玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: Layered in a shot glass.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入几乎装满冰块的高球杯中。搅拌均匀。
instructions.en: Pour all of the ingredients into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分（薄荷除外）与冰混合并摇匀，滤入装有冰块的老式玻璃杯中。添加薄荷枝即可食用。
instructions.en: Combine and shake all ingredients (except mint) with ice and strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes. Add the sprig of mint and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分放入鸡尾酒调酒器和冰块中摇匀，然后滤入冷玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: Shake all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker and ice then strain in a cold glass.

instructions.zh: 首先是151，然后是101，配上可口可乐或胡椒博士的饮料。
instructions.en: Poor in the 151 first followed by the 101 served with a Coke or Dr Pepper chaser.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合所有成分。摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 将两种苦艾酒放入调酒器中混合，滤入冷玻璃杯中。注入一滴苏打水。
instructions.en: Mix both the vermouth's in a shaker and strain into a cold glass. Top up with a squirt of Soda Water.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分摇匀，滤入冷玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.

instructions.zh: 将杜松子酒、橙汁和蔓越莓汁倒入高球杯中的冰块上。淋上苏打水即可享用。
instructions.en: Pour schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice over ice in a highball glass. Top with club soda and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的搅拌杯中，混合所有成分。搅拌均匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 混合。加冰食用。
instructions.en: Mix. Serve over ice.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，然后将内容物滤入鸡尾酒杯中。在上面撒上肉豆蔻即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料与冰混合并摇匀，将内容物滤入鸡尾酒杯中，即可享用。
instructions.en: Combine and shake all ingredients with ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（柠檬皮除外）加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。上面撒上柠檬皮，即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the twist of lemon peel and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合所有成分。摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 将加冰的金巴利酒和苦艾酒倒入玻璃杯中，加入少许苏打水，并用半片橙片装饰。
instructions.en: Pour the Campari and vermouth over ice into glass, add a splash of soda water and garnish with half orange slice.

instructions.zh: 搅拌。用马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。
instructions.en: Stirr. Grnish with maraschino cherry.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将伏特加和杜松子酒倒入冰块中，加入汤力水并搅拌
instructions.en: Pour Vodka and Gin over ice, add Tonic and Stir

instructions.zh: 在加冰的高球杯中混合，摇匀。
instructions.en: Mix in highball glass over ice, shake well.

instructions.zh: 在一个高脚玻璃杯中装满冰块。将芬兰伏特加、柠檬汁和苹果汁、Pisang Ambon 分层，最后加入柠檬水。稍微搅拌，用螺旋黄瓜皮和红樱桃装饰。黄瓜提供了热情并且看起来很有吸引力。这款饮料由蒂莫·海米 (Timo Haimi) 创造，在 1991 年芬兰迪亚伏特加长饮大赛中获得一等奖。
instructions.en: Fill a tall glass with ice. Layer the Finlandia Vodka, lemon and apple juices, Pisang Ambon, and top up with lemonade. Stir slightly and garnish with a spiralled cucumber skin and a red cherry. The cucumber provides zest and looks attractive. This drink, created by Timo Haimi, took first prize in the 1991 Finlandia Vodka Long Drink Competition.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分添加到装满冰块的鸡尾酒调酒器中。充分摇匀并滤入鸡尾酒杯。用樱桃装饰。
instructions.en: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass. Garnish with a cherry.

instructions.zh: 将原料分层放入小玻璃杯中。用搅拌器食用。
instructions.en: Layer ingredients into a shot glass. Serve with a stirrer.

instructions.zh: 按顺序将 Kahlua、Sambucca 和 Grand Marnier 倒入小玻璃杯中。比 B-52 更好
instructions.en: Layer the Kahlua, Sambucca and Grand Marnier into a shot glas in that order. Better than B-52

instructions.zh: 将冰淇淋放置约 10 分钟。按顺序加入材料，用筷子搅拌（黄油刀或勺子也可以）。立即并经常食用。美味又清淡，非常适合在喝了很多酒后饮用。
instructions.en: Leave ice-cream out for about 10 minutes. Add ingredients in order, stir with chopstick (butter knife or spoon works too). Consume immediately and often. Nice and light, great for following a heavy drink.

instructions.zh:
添加 2 份苏打水或根据口味添加或添加少量。

将它们混合在一起并倒在一堆冰上。用吸管喝。
instructions.en:
Add 2 parts club soda or more or less to taste.

Mix it all together and pour over a bunch of ice. Drink with a straw.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的搅拌杯中，混合所有成分。搅拌均匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 将配料与冰摇匀。滤入玻璃杯，上面倒入起泡酒。
instructions.en: Shake pour ingredients with ice. Strain into glass, top with Sparkling wine.

instructions.zh: 将桃泥倒入冰镇的笛形杯中，加入起泡酒。轻轻搅拌。
instructions.en: Pour peach purée into chilled flute, add sparkling wine. Stir gently.

instructions.zh: 混合所有成分，倒在冰上。
instructions.en: Mix all ingredients, and pour over ice.

instructions.zh: 将原料倒入 1 盎司小玻璃杯中
instructions.en: Pour ingredients into 1 ounce shot glass

instructions.zh: 加入冰块搅拌混合杯并过滤
instructions.en: Stir in mixing glass with ice and strain

instructions.zh: 将黑刺李杜松子酒和苦艾酒加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。加入柠檬皮，即可食用。
instructions.en: Stir sloe gin and vermouth with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯碎冰的搅拌杯中，将杜松子酒、三秒酒、库拉索酒和苦味酒混合。搅拌均匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯，用柠檬片和樱桃装饰。
instructions.en: In a mixing glass half-filled with crushed ice, combine the gin, triple sec, Curacao, and bitters. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the lemon twist and the cherry.

instructions.zh: 放入 2 盎司的小酒杯或小酒杯中
instructions.en: Layer in a 2 oz shot glass or pony glass

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的调酒杯中，将杜松子酒、苦艾酒、苦味酒和黑樱桃利口酒混合。搅拌均匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯并用樱桃装饰。
instructions.en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, vermouth, bitters, and maraschino liqueur. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the cherry.

instructions.zh: 在搅拌机或摇酒器中准备，放入高球杯中加冰块。用 1 片菠萝和一颗樱桃装饰。
instructions.en: Prepare in a blender or shaker, serve in a highball glass on the rocks. Garnish with 1 slice of pineapple and one cherry.

instructions.zh: 将柠檬汁、糖粉、混合威士忌和蛋清与碎冰一起摇匀，滤入威士忌酸杯中。添加柠檬片，上面放上樱桃，即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake juice of lemon, powdered sugar, blended whiskey, and egg white with cracked ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Add the slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合所有成分。摇匀。滤入酸玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分混合在一起。慢慢地、轻轻地。如果在潘趣酒碗中加冰且苏打水非常冷，效果最佳。
instructions.en: Mix all ingredients together. Slowly and gently. Works best if ice is added to punch bowl and soda's are very cold.

instructions.zh: 在玻璃杯中装满碎冰。加入杜松子酒、柠檬汁和简单糖浆。搅拌，然后以圆形方式倒入黑莓利口酒，以产生大理石花纹效果。用两颗黑莓和柠檬片装饰。
instructions.en: Fill glass with crushed ice. Build gin, lemon juice and simple syrup over. Stir, and then pour blackberry liqueur over in a circular fashion to create marbling effect. Garnish with two blackberries and lemon slice.

instructions.zh: 将配料放入温热的杯子中混合并搅拌。
instructions.en: Mix ingredients in a warmed mug and stir.

instructions.zh: 将玻璃杯装满一半的冰块。将艾草压碎并加入冰中。倒入朗姆酒、苏格兰威士忌和黄油，即可上桌！
instructions.en: Half fill the glass with ice cubes. Crush the wormwood and add to ice. Pour rum, scotch and butters, then serve!

instructions.zh: 将原料与冰混合，搅拌直至充分冷却。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。
instructions.en: Combine ingredients with ice and stir until well-chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 按顺序分层放入小玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: Layer in order into a shot glass.

instructions.zh: 将 Corona 倒入 18 盎司的啤酒杯中 将百加得柠檬倒入啤酒中，轻轻搅拌
instructions.en: Pour the corona into an 18oz beer glass pour the bacardi limon into the beer stir very gently

instructions.zh: 这是一个分层的镜头。首先将贝利酒倒入小酒杯中。然后拿一个倒置的勺子，将其接触到玻璃的内壁。小心地添加咖啡壶。对 Sambuca 重复此过程。如果操作得当，酒精会保持分离状态，就像大黄蜂一样。享受！！！
instructions.en: This is a layered shot. First pour the Bailey's into the shot glass. Then take an upside down spoon and touch it to the inside wall of the glass. Carefully add the Kahlua. Repeat this process for the Sambuca. If done properly, the alcohol will stay separated and resemble a bumble bee. Enjoy!!!

instructions.zh: 将咖啡装满杯子，几乎达到顶部。加入牛奶、橙皮秒和白兰地。搅拌。
instructions.en: Fill mug almost to top with coffee.Add milk, triple sec and brandy. Stir.

instructions.zh: 将酸橙和糖放入老式玻璃杯中并搅拌（使用搅拌器或木勺将两种成分捣碎在一起）。将玻璃杯装满冰块，然后加入卡莎萨酒。
instructions.en: Place lime and sugar into old fashioned glass and muddle (mash the two ingredients together using a muddler or a wooden spoon). Fill the glass with ice and add the Cachaça.

instructions.zh: 与凯匹林纳鸡尾酒相同，但您添加的是白朗姆酒而不是卡查卡酒。这很棒！！！！！！！！
instructions.en: Same as Caipirinha but instead of cachaca you add WHITE RUM. It's great!!!!!!!!

instructions.zh: 使用 15 盎司的玻璃杯。首先添加金巴利。装满啤酒。
instructions.en: Use a 15 oz glass. Add Campari first. Fill with beer.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。摇匀。滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。用柠檬片和樱桃装饰。无需吸管即可食用。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a lemon twist and a maraschino cherry. Serve without a straw.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合所有成分。摇匀。滤入酸玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（碳酸水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入盛有两块冰块的高球杯中。加入碳酸水，搅拌，即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将棒放入少量沸水中融化。添加牛奶。用小火煮，轻轻搅打（我想是用搅拌器）直到充分加热。不要让它沸腾！盛入咖啡杯中。
instructions.en: Melt the bar in a small amount of boiling water. Add milk. Cook over low heat, whipping gently (with a whisk, i would assume) until heated well. Don't let it boil! Serve in coffee mug.

instructions.zh: 将牛奶放入底部，将利口酒倒在上面，然后加入少许苦杏酒。不要混合。猛击它！
instructions.en: Put the milk in the bottom, pour the Liquer on top and add the dash of amaretto. Do not mix. SLAM IT!

instructions.zh: 将一半可乐倒入玻璃杯中。然后加入百加得，最后加入剩余的可乐。搅拌均匀即可饮用！
instructions.en: Pour half of coke in a glass. Then add Bacardi and top it off with the remaining coke. Stir and drink up!

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合所有成分。摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将原料干摇至乳化，加冰，摇匀，直接饮用。
instructions.en: Dry shake ingredients to emulsify, add ice, shake and served straight up.

instructions.zh: 将咖啡、糖和水混合。煮1小时并冷却。添加香草和伏特加。在密封罐中陈化2至3周。
instructions.en: Combine coffee, sugar and water. Simmer 1 hour and let cool. Add vanilla and vodka. Age in sealed jar 2 to 3 weeks.

instructions.zh: 将水和糖煮沸直至溶解。关掉暖气。慢慢加入干速溶咖啡并继续搅拌。将切碎的香草豆加入伏特加中，然后将冷却的糖浆和咖啡溶液与伏特加混合。盖紧盖子并每天剧烈摇晃，持续 3 周。过滤并过滤。最好让糖混合物完全冷却，这样伏特加在添加时就不会蒸发。如果您喜欢利口酒的顺滑口感，可以在成品中添加约 1 茶匙甘油。
instructions.en: Boil water and sugar until dissolved. Turn off heat. Slowly add dry instant coffee and continue stirring. Add a chopped vanilla bean to the vodka, then combine the cooled sugar syrup and coffee solution with the vodka. Cover tightly and shake vigorously each day for 3 weeks. Strain and filter. Its also best to let the sugar mixture cool completely so the vodka won't evaporate when its added. If you like a smoother feel to the liqueur you can add about 1 teaspoon of glycerine to the finished product.

instructions.zh: 拿一个玻璃杯，将可乐倒入杯中，然后滴入7滴柠檬汁。将柠檬片放在玻璃杯边缘进行装饰。
instructions.en: Take a glass, pour the Coke in the glass, then you take 7 drops of lemon juice. Granish with a lemon slice on the rim of the glass.

instructions.zh: 再次将半个酸橙切成两半。将青柠、法乐努和苦精倒入岩石杯中。混乱。添加朗姆酒。 （推荐陈年巴巴多斯朗姆酒，例如Plantation 5 Year）。加冰并搅拌。将黑带朗姆酒浮在上面。用吸管食用。
instructions.en: Cut the half lime in half again. Add the lime, falernum, and bitters to a rocks glass. Muddle. Add the rum. (Aged Barbados rum such as Plantation 5 Year is recommended). Add ice and stir. Float the blackstrap rum on top. Serve with a straw.

instructions.zh: 摇匀，过滤，直接饮用，鸡尾酒杯用苦艾酒冲洗
instructions.en: Shake, strain, straight up, cocktail glass rinsed with absinthe

instructions.zh: 将所有成分添加到装满冰块的鸡尾酒调酒器中。摇匀并双重滤入大鸡尾酒杯中。用石灰轮装饰。
instructions.en: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and double strain into large cocktail glass. Garnish with lime wheel.

instructions.zh: 混合前四种成分。搅拌直至糖溶解，冷却。然后在食用前加入姜汁汽水。添加冰环以保持冲床冷却。
instructions.en: Combine first four ingredients. Stir until sugar is dissolved, chill. Then add ginger ale just before serving. Add ice ring to keep punch cold.

instructions.zh: 将 1 盎司香料朗姆酒倒入装有冰块的高球杯中。倒入姜汁汽水。
instructions.en: Pour 1oz of Spiced Rum into a highball glass with ice. Fill with Ginger Ale.

instructions.zh: 在高脚玻璃杯中装满冰块。添加朗姆酒。将切下的酸橙边缘擦在玻璃杯边缘，然后将果汁挤入玻璃杯中。装满可口可乐。用酸橙片装饰。享受！
instructions.en: Fill tall glass with ice cubes. Add rum. Rub cut edge of lime on rim of glass then squeeze juice into glass. Fill with Coca-Cola. Garnish with lime slice. Enjoy!

instructions.zh: 将所有原料放入装满冰块的柯林斯玻璃杯中。用酸橙角装饰。
instructions.en: Build all ingredients in a Collins glass filled with ice. Garnish with lime wedge.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。摇匀。滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 倒入小玻璃杯中。放入口中。根据需要重复。
instructions.en: Pour into shot glass. Put in mouth. Repeat as deemed necessary.

instructions.zh: 倒入并混合。
instructions.en: pour it in and mix it.

instructions.zh: 在装满冰块的高球杯中加入 6 厘升黑朗姆酒，并在上面倒入姜汁啤酒。用酸橙角装饰。
instructions.en: In a highball glass filled with ice add 6cl dark rum and top with ginger beer. Garnish with lime wedge.

instructions.zh:
将糖混入老式玻璃杯中的酸橙块中。
将玻璃杯装满冰块。
将卡查卡倒入玻璃杯中。
搅拌均匀。
instructions.en:
Muddle the sugar into the lime wedges in an old-fashioned glass.
Fill the glass with ice cubes.
Pour the cachaca into the glass.
Stir well.

instructions.zh: 有很多优质的樱桃利口酒可供选择，但我更喜欢 Heering。添加一份利口酒。然后添加一份苏打水。对于酸吊带，请使用滋补品（大多数人更喜欢不添加滋补品的饮料）。然后在玻璃杯中倒入橙汁和冰块。
instructions.en: There are many good cherry liqueurs you can use, but I prefere Heering. Add one share of the liqueur. Then you add one share of Soda. For a sour sling use Tonic (most people prefer the drink without Tonic). Afterwards you fill the glass with Orange Juice and ice cubes.

instructions.zh: 随心所欲，将苦艾酒倒入冰镇的玻璃杯中，倒入香槟。必须在中午饮用才能达到最佳效果。
instructions.en: Easy as you like, pour the absinthe into a chilled glass, top with champagne. Must be drunk mid afternoon for the optimum effect.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入装有冰块的搅拌杯中。搅拌。滤入鸡尾酒杯。在饮料中加入一枝新鲜薄荷装饰。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice. Stir. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a sprig of fresh mint in the drink.

instructions.zh: 先倒入啤酒，然后加入黑加仑甜酒。加满苹果酒。颜色应该非常深，接近吉尼斯的颜色。
instructions.en: Pour the lager first then add the blackcurrant cordial. Top up with the cider. The colour sholud be very dark approaching the colour of Guiness.

instructions.zh:
将伏特加、干苦艾酒和橄榄盐水倒入鸡尾酒调酒器中，加入少量冰块，摇匀。
用柠檬角擦拭马提尼酒杯的边缘。
将鸡尾酒调酒器中的内容物滤入玻璃杯中，然后添加橄榄。
肮脏的马提尼酒含有少量的橄榄盐水或橄榄汁，通常用橄榄装饰。
instructions.en:
Pour the vodka, dry vermouth and olive brine into a cocktail shaker with a handful of ice and shake well.
Rub the rim of a martini glass with the wedge of lemon.
Strain the contents of the cocktail shaker into the glass and add the olive.
A dirty Martini contains a splash of olive brine or olive juice and is typically garnished with an olive.

instructions.zh: 这是一个分层的镜头 - 贝利酒必须在上面
instructions.en: This is a layered shot - the Bailey's must be on top

instructions.zh: 从精灵开始。接下来是龙舌兰酒。之后，加入美汁源水果潘趣酒，然后加入 151. Rocks（可选）。
instructions.en: Start with the Sprite. Next comes the tequila. After that, add the Minute Maid Fruit Punch, then float the 151. Rocks optional.

instructions.zh: 在几乎装满冰块的高球杯中，将杜松子酒和姜汁汽水混合。搅拌均匀。用青柠角装饰。
instructions.en: In a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and ginger ale. Stir well. Garnish with the lime wedge.

instructions.zh: 将奶油和牛奶与肉桂和香草豆一起慢慢加热 15-20 分钟。 （如果没有豆子，加热后添加1-2茶匙香草精）。取出豆子和肉桂。添加巧克力。混合直至完全融化。上面撒上一些非常浓稠的新鲜奶油。份量为 1-2 人，具体取决于您的贪食程度。要获得更浓郁的巧克力，请使用 4 盎司牛奶、4 盎司奶油、4 盎司巧克力。盛入咖啡杯中。
instructions.en: Heat the cream and milk with the cinnamon and vanilla bean very slowly for 15-20 minutes. (If you don't have any beans add 1-2 tsp of vanilla after heating). Remove the bean and cinnamon. Add the chocolate. Mix until fully melted. Serve topped with some very dense fresh whipped cream. Serves 1-2 depending upon how much of a glutton you are. For a richer chocolate, use 4 oz of milk, 4 oz of cream, 4 oz of chocolate. Serve in coffee mug.

instructions.zh: 直接：将所有原料倒入装有冰块的混合杯中。搅拌均匀。滤入冰镇马提尼鸡尾酒杯。将柠檬皮中的油挤到饮料上，或用橄榄装饰。
instructions.en: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with olive.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的搅拌杯中，将苏格兰威士忌和苦艾酒混合。搅拌均匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。用柠檬片装饰。
instructions.en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（柠檬皮除外）与冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。加入柠檬皮，即可食用。
instructions.en: Stir all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

instructions.zh:
摇匀所有成分。
在装有大冰块的冰镇双层老式玻璃杯中双重过滤。
用几根薰衣草小枝装饰
instructions.en:
Shake all ingredients.
Double strain in a chilled double old fashioned glass with abig ice cube.
Garnish with a couple of lavender sprigs

instructions.zh: 在喷泉杯中混合糖浆和牛奶。加入苏打水，用吸管饮用。
instructions.en: Mix syrup and milk in a fountain glass. Add soda water, serve with a straw.

instructions.zh: 将鸡蛋替代品和糖搅打在一起，与两种牛奶、香草和朗姆酒混合。搅拌均匀。过夜冷却。撒上肉豆蔻。做 6 份。
instructions.en: Whip egg substitute and sugar together, combine with the two kinds of milk, vanilla, and rum. Mix well. Chill over night. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Makes 6 servings.

instructions.zh: 在一个小搅拌碗中搅拌蛋黄直至混合。逐渐加入 1/4 杯糖，高速搅打至浓稠并呈柠檬色。加入牛奶、朗姆酒、波本威士忌、香草和盐搅拌。彻底冷却。搅打奶油。好好清洗搅拌器。在一个大搅拌碗中搅拌蛋白直至形成软峰。逐渐加入剩余的 1/4 杯糖，搅打至硬性发泡。将蛋黄混合物和鲜奶油拌入蛋白中。立即上菜。在每份食物上撒上肉豆蔻。盛入潘趣酒碗或另一个大碗中。注意：对于不含酒精的蛋酒，按照上述方法准备蛋酒，只是省略波旁威士忌和朗姆酒并将牛奶增加到 3 杯。
instructions.en: In a small mixer bowl beat egg yolks till blended. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating at high speed till thick and lemon colored. Stir in milk, stir in rum, bourbon, vanilla, and salt. Chill thoroughly. Whip cream. Wash beaters well. In a large mixer bowl beat egg whites till soft peaks form. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar, beating to stiff peaks. Fold yolk mixture and whipped cream into egg whites. Serve immediately. Sprinkle nutmeg over each serving. Serve in a punch bowl or another big bowl. NOTE: For a nonalcoholic eggnog, prepare Eggnog as above, except omit the bourbon and rum and increase the milk to 3 cups.

instructions.zh: 如果需要，在大平底锅中将鸡蛋、糖和盐搅拌在一起。加入2杯牛奶搅拌。用小火煮，不断搅拌，直到混合物浓稠到足以覆盖金属勺子并达到 160 华氏度。离火。加入剩余的 2 杯牛奶和香草精。盖上盖子并重新冷藏几个小时或过夜，直至完全冷却。食用前，倒入碗或水罐中。如果需要，可以装饰或添加搅拌物。选择一种或多种：巧克力卷、肉桂棒、调味品提取物、调味白兰地或利口酒、果汁或花蜜、肉豆蔻粉、黑樱桃、橙片、薄荷棒或棒棒糖、原味白兰地、淡奶油或威士忌、果子露或冰淇淋、掼奶油、搅打奶油。立即上菜。
instructions.en: In large saucepan, beat together eggs, sugar and salt, if desired. Stir in 2 cups of the milk. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough to coat a metal spoon and reaches 160 degrees F. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining 2 cups milk and vanilla. Cover and regfigerate until thoroughly chilled, several hours or overnight. Just before serving, pour into bowl or pitcher. Garnish or add stir-ins, if desired. Choose 1 or several of: Chocolate curls, cinnamon sticks, extracts of flavorings, flavored brandy or liqueur, fruit juice or nectar, ground nutmeg, maraschino cherries, orange slices, peppermint sticks or candy canes, plain brandy, run or whiskey, sherbet or ice-cream, whipping cream, whipped. Serve immediately.

instructions.zh: 拿起玻璃杯，将石灰混入其中。在玻璃杯中装满碎冰，然后加入卡查卡酒。充分搅拌，然后在上面再加一些碎冰。用酸橙装饰即可享用！
instructions.en: Take the glass and muddle the lime in it. Fill the glass with crushed ice and add the Cachaca. Stir well and top with some more crushed ice. Garnish with lime and enjoy!

instructions.zh:
为了确保你的猪油和他们的一样美味，这是他们的阿多波腌料以及如何处理它（你还需要一排排骨）：

4 个安乔辣椒、8 个瓜希略辣椒和 4 个墨西哥辣椒，加上 4 瓣烤大蒜、半杯苹果醋、四分之一茶匙墨西哥牛至、一茶匙黑胡椒粉、一整瓣丁香、四分之一茶匙肉桂粉和半茶匙孜然粉。

烤干辣椒并在水中浸泡至少一个小时，直到它们重新水化。沥干并丢弃浸泡液。将浸泡过的辣椒与剩余的原料混合，打成泥，直至光滑。

拿一个酒店用的大平底锅，一侧放木片，另一侧放木炭，冷熏一排小排骨。将另一个较小的装有排骨的平底锅放在木炭/木片平底锅上方。点燃木炭，小心不要点燃木片。用箔纸盖住两个平底锅，熏 10-15 分钟，直到达到所需的烟雾水平，然后涂上阿斗波腌料并用锡纸包裹，然后将排骨放入 300 度的烤箱中烤 7 小时。当排骨冷却后，滤去脂肪并用于输液。

如果你很难达到同样数量的脂肪，可以用屠夫的猪油来补充。为了在没有排骨的情况下获得同样深度的味道，可以用几勺腌料在锅中加热脂肪。

一旦你得到一桶冷却液体形式的调味猪肉脂肪，将等量的非法青年梅斯卡尔酒和脂肪倒入可密封的容器中。密封容器并充分摇匀，然后将其放入冰箱过夜。当整个东西分离并凝结时，将其倒入细网中国。如果您没有中国式过滤器，请尝试使用细网过滤器，或者如果您没有其中之一，请尝试用勺子舀掉大部分脂肪。过滤后的梅斯卡尔酒中会残留一些橙色脂肪珠：将其穿过几层粗棉布（必要时或咖啡过滤器）以除去最后的脂肪。

梅斯卡尔酒现在可以直接饮用或调制成鸡尾酒了。 

哈瓦那酊剂

将哈瓦那辣椒切片并添加 2 盎司非法青年梅斯卡尔酒。
放置过夜或直至达到所需的热量水平。
鸡尾酒

将梅斯卡尔酒和巧克力利口酒放入混合杯中，加入冰块，搅拌 45 秒。
滤入冰镇的轿跑车。
用勺子小心地将咖啡利口酒“沉入”轿跑车的内部。
用 5 滴哈瓦那酊剂装饰。
instructions.en:
To ensure that your pork fat is just as delicious as theirs, here’s their adobo marinade and what to do with it (you’ll also need a rack of ribs):

4 ancho chiles, 8 guajillo chiles and 4 chipotle chiles, plus 4 cloves roasted garlic, half a cup of cider vinegar, a quarter teaspoon of Mexican oregano, 1 teaspoon of ground black pepper, a whole clove, a quarter teaspoon of ground cinnamon and a half teaspoon of ground cumin.

Toast the dried chiles and soak in water for at least an hour until they are rehydrated. Drain and discard the soaking liquid. Combine the soaked chiles with the remaining ingredients and purée until smooth.

Cold smoke a rack of baby back pork ribs by taking a large hotel pan with woodchips on one side and charcoal on the other. Place another, smaller, pan with pork ribs, above the charcoal/woodchip pan. Ignite the charcoal, being careful to not ignite the woodchips. Cover both pans with foil and allow to smoke for 10-15 minutes, until desired level of smoke is achieved, then coat with adobo marinade and wrap in tin foil prior to placing ribs in a 300 degree oven for 7 hours. When the ribs have cooled, strain off the fat and use for the infusion.

If you’re having a hard time coming up to the same kind of volume of fat, make up the balance with pork lard from a butcher. To get the same depth of flavor without the ribs, heat up the fat in a pot with a few spoons of the marinade.

Once you’ve got your tub of seasoned pork fat in cooled liquid form, pour equal amounts of Ilegal Joven mezcal and fat into a sealable container. Seal the container and give it a really good shake, then put it in the freezer overnight. When the whole thing is separated and congealed, pour it through a fine mesh chinoise. If you don’t have a chinoise, try a fine mesh strainer, or if you don’t have one of those, try spooning off most of the fat. There will be some beads of orange fat left in the strained mezcal: run that through a few layers of cheesecloth (or coffee filters in a pinch) to get rid of the last of it.

The mezcal is now ready for drinking, straight-up or in a cocktail. 

Habanero tincture

Slice habaneros and add 2 ounces Ilegal Joven mezcal.
Allow to sit overnight or until desired level of heat is achieved.
Cocktail

Combine mezcal and chocolate liqueur in a mixing glass with ice and stir for 45 seconds.
Strain into chilled coupe.
Carefully "sink" the coffee liqueur down the inside of the coupe over a spoon.
Garnish with 5 drops habanero tincture.

instructions.zh: 将白兰地、杜松子酒和甜苦艾酒倒入装有冰块的高球杯中。加满碳酸水。加入柠檬皮，搅拌，即可食用。 （如果愿意，可以用姜汁汽水代替碳酸水。）
instructions.en: Pour brandy, gin, and sweet vermouth into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water. Add the twist of lemon peel, stir, and serve. (Ginger ale may be substituted for carbonated water, if preferred.)

instructions.zh: 用柠檬汁擦拭鸡尾酒杯的边缘，然后将玻璃杯的边缘浸入糖粉中。将所有原料（樱桃除外）加冰摇匀，滤入糖边玻璃杯中。上面放上樱桃即可食用。
instructions.en: Rub rim of cocktail glass with lemon juice and dip rim of glass in powdered sugar. Shake all ingredients (except cherry) with ice and strain into sugar-rimmed glass. Top with the cherry and serve.

instructions.zh: 将原料倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中，剧烈摇晃，然后滤入冰镇的马提尼杯中
instructions.en: Pour ingredients into shaker filled with ice, shake vigorously, and strain into chilled martini glass

instructions.zh: 在鸡尾酒杯中混合在一起。用一些巧克力粉和咖啡豆装饰
instructions.en: Mix together in a cocktail glass. Garnish with some choclate powder and coffee beans

instructions.zh: 用塔巴斯科酱覆盖小酒杯底部，然后倒入一半 Firewater 和一半 Absolut Peppar。
instructions.en: Cover bottom of shot glass with Tabasco Sauce and then fill with half Firewater and half Absolut Peppar.

instructions.zh: 在刘易斯袋中，像球手/疯子一样碾碎一些冰块（@glacioice）。将珍贵的冰块倒入柯林斯玻璃杯中。在鸡尾酒调酒器中，将无花果和百里香混合在一起。添加蜂蜜伏特加、柠檬汁和一大块冰块（@glacioice）。摇匀直至充分冷却，然后滤入玻璃杯中。添加汤力水，最后加入 2 滴安戈斯图拉苦精。用切片无花果和百里香装饰。
instructions.en: In a lewis bag, crush up some ice like a baller/maniac (@glacioice). Pour your precious ice into a collins glass. In a cocktail shaker, muddle the figs and thyme together. Add honey vodka, lemon juice, and a large ice cube (@glacioice). Shake until well chilled, and strain into glass. Add tonic water and finally 2 dashes of angostura bitters. Garnish with sliced figs and thyme.

instructions.zh: 添加苦杏酒、百加得和伏特加。加入胡椒博士和啤酒
instructions.en: Add Amaretto, Bacardi, and vodka. Mix in the Dr. Pepper and beer

instructions.zh: 将 Sambuca 和 Kahlua 倒入鸡尾酒杯中，并给饮用者一根吸管。将百利甜酒和蓝柑橘倒入鸡尾酒杯两侧的两个单独的小玻璃杯中。点燃鸡尾酒杯中的混合物，开始用吸管饮用（这种饮料应该一次喝完），当到达玻璃杯底部时，将百利甜酒和蓝柑橘倒入鸡尾酒杯中，继续饮用，直到全部消失！
instructions.en: Pour the Sambuca and Kahlua into the Cocktail Glass and give the drinker a straw. Pour the Baileys and Blue Curacao into two sepsrate shot glasses either side of the cocktail glass. Set light the concotion in the cocktail glass and start to drink through the straw (this drink should be drunk in one) , as the bottom of the glass is reached put out the fire by pouring the Baileys and Blue Curacao into the cocktail glass and keep drinking till it's all gone!!

instructions.zh: 把他们俩都打进去。
instructions.en: Bang 'em both in.

instructions.zh: 在一个几乎装满冰块的老式玻璃杯中，将杜松子酒和三秒酒混合。搅拌均匀。
instructions.en: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and triple sec. Stir well.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 混合在一起。以最高搅拌机速度搅拌约 1 分钟。倒入玻璃杯中，用吸管饮用。注意：如果一切都是冷的，这个效果最好（如果你是新鲜咖啡，将其与牛奶混合，然后放在冰箱中1/2小时。如果没有泡沫，请添加更多牛奶，甚至只是更多奶粉。泡沫在杯底逐渐变成液体，所以你会发现你可以坐下来喝大约1/2小时，更多的冰咖啡不断出现在底部。非常清爽。
instructions.en: Mix together. Blend at highest blender speed for about 1 minute. Pour into a glass and drink with a straw. Notes: This works best if everything is cold (if you make fresh coffee, mix it with the milk and let it sit in the fridge for 1/2 hour. If it is not frothy, add more milk, or even just some more milk powder. The froth gradually turns to liquid at the bottom of the glass, so you will find that you can sit and drink this for about 1/2 hour, with more iced coffee continually appearing at the bottom. Very refreshing.

instructions.zh: 拍一张足够大的照片！！
instructions.en: make it an ample size shot!!

instructions.zh: 将杜松子酒、糖和柠檬汁放入装满冰块的鸡尾酒调酒器中混合。用力摇晃并滤入冰镇的香槟杯中。加满香槟。轻轻搅拌。
instructions.en: Combine gin, sugar, and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake vigorously and strain into a chilled champagne glass. Top up with Champagne. Stir gently.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料直接倒入装有冰块的老式玻璃杯中。轻轻搅拌。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。充分摇匀并滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。将柠檬皮上的油挤到饮料上。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink.

instructions.zh:
在摇酒壶中加入冰块，倒入所有原料。
使用吧勺搅拌 40 至 45 转或直至完全冷却。
滤入马提尼杯或加冰后倒入岩石杯中。用橙色麻花装饰。
instructions.en:
Add ice to a shaker and pour in all ingredients.
Using a bar spoon, stir 40 to 45 revolutions or until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a martini glass or over ice into a rocks glass. Garnish with orange twist.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（柠檬片和酸橙片除外）加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸玻璃杯中。用柠檬片和酸橙片装饰即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except slices of lemon and lime) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Decorate with the slices of lemon and lime and serve.

instructions.zh:
步骤1
将桃红葡萄酒倒入 13x9" 平底锅中，冷冻至少 6 小时，直至几乎凝固（由于酒精的作用，它不会完全凝固）。

步骤2
与此同时，将糖和 ½ 杯水放入中型平底锅中煮沸；煮约 3 分钟，不断搅拌，直至糖溶解。加入草莓，离火，静置 30 分钟，使糖浆充满草莓味。通过细网筛滤入小碗中（不要压在固体上）；盖上盖子，冷藏约 30 分钟，直至变冷。

步骤3
将桃红葡萄酒刮入搅拌机中。加入柠檬汁、3.5 盎司草莓糖浆、1 杯碎冰和果泥，直至变得光滑。将搅拌杯放入冰箱并冷冻 25-35 分钟，直至霜冻变稠（目标是奶昔稠度）。

步骤4
再次搅拌直至霜冻变成泥状。划分眼镜。

步骤5
提前做：桃红葡萄酒可以提前 1 周冷冻。
instructions.en:
Step 1
Pour rosé into a 13x9" pan and freeze until almost solid (it won't completely solidify due to the alcohol), at least 6 hours.

Step 2
Meanwhile, bring sugar and ½ cup water to a boil in a medium saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes. Add strawberries, remove from heat, and let sit 30 minutes to infuse syrup with strawberry flavor. Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a small bowl (do not press on solids); cover and chill until cold, about 30 minutes.

Step 3
Scrape rosé into a blender. Add lemon juice, 3½ ounces strawberry syrup, and 1 cup crushed ice and purée until smooth. Transfer blender jar to freezer and freeze until frosé is thickened (aim for milkshake consistency), 25–35 minutes.

Step 4
Blend again until frosé is slushy. Divide among glasses.

Step 5
Do Ahead: Rosé can be frozen 1 week ahead.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分（樱桃除外）混合在电动搅拌机中，低速搅拌五秒钟，然后高速搅拌直至变硬。将内容物倒入香槟杯中，上面撒上樱桃，即可享用。
instructions.en: Combine all ingredients (except for the cherry) in an electric blender and blend at a low speed for five seconds, then blend at a high speed until firm. Pour contents into a champagne flute, top with the cherry, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料与 1 杯碎冰放入电动搅拌机中混合。低速短时间搅拌。倒入老式玻璃杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料与 1 杯碎冰放入电动搅拌机中混合。低速短时间搅拌。倒入鸡尾酒杯即可享用。
instructions.en: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into a cocktail glass and serve.

instructions.zh: 将草莓与糖拌匀，然后在冰箱中放置过夜。切开柠檬，保留两片。剩下的榨汁。将柠檬汁、草莓、苹果汁和苏打水混合在一起。添加柠檬片（装饰，真的）。在玻璃杯中放入冰块和一片苹果。倒入饮料，即可享用。
instructions.en: Toss strawberries with sugar, and let sit overnight in refrigerator. Cut lemon, reserve two slices. Juice the rest. Mix together the lemon juice, strawberries, apple juice, and soda water. Add slices of lemon (decor, really). In glasses, put ice cubes, and a slice of apple. Pour drink in, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料放入搅拌杯中 - 盖上盖子并以中速搅拌直至充分混合。倒入 1 个高杯、2 个中杯或 3 个小杯，然后喝完。
instructions.en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

instructions.zh: 搅拌直至光滑。
instructions.en: Blend til smooth.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分混合在一起，滤入柯林斯杯中。尽可能使用牙买加朗姆酒以获得更正宗的味道。
instructions.en: Mix all ingredients together and strain into a Collins glass. Use Jamaican rum where possible for a more authentic taste.

instructions.zh: 将咖啡杯装满一半的咖啡。将另一半装满桃子杜松子酒。搅拌并趁热饮用。
instructions.en: fill coffe mug half full of coffee. Fill the other half full of Peach Schnapps. Stir and drink while hot.

instructions.zh: 摇匀并装入鸡尾酒杯中。这是意大利帕维亚的American/Internet Bar del Pozzo 的家庭鸡尾酒。
instructions.en: Shake well and serve in a cocktail glass. This is a home cocktail of American/Internet Bar del Pozzo, Pavia, Italy.

instructions.zh: 将加利亚诺利口酒倒在冰上。将杯子的剩余部分倒入姜汁汽水，仅此而已。现在你已经有了一个属于你自己的GG了。
instructions.en: Pour the Galliano liqueur over ice. Fill the remainder of the glass with ginger ale and thats all there is to it. You now have a your very own GG.

instructions.zh:
将所有原料放入摇酒壶中并加满冰块。

摇匀，滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯或装满新鲜冰块的老式玻璃杯中。

用石灰轮装饰。
instructions.en:
Add all the ingredients to a shaker and fill with ice.

Shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass or an Old Fashioned glass filled with fresh ice.

Garnish with a lime wheel.

instructions.zh:
将杜松子酒和苏打水倒入几乎装满冰块的高球杯中。
搅拌均匀。
用青柠角装饰。
instructions.en:
Pour the Gin and Soda water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

instructions.zh: 搅拌糖粉和 2 盎司。柯林斯玻璃杯中的碳酸水。在玻璃杯中装满冰块，然后加入杜松子酒。加入碳酸水并搅拌。添加柠檬皮和橙色螺旋，使橙色螺旋的末端悬挂在玻璃边缘上。
instructions.en: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice and add gin. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Add the lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end of the orange spiral dangles over rim of glass.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，将杜松子酒、柠檬汁、糖和石榴糖浆混合。摇匀。倒入老式玻璃杯中，用樱桃和橙片装饰。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, sugar, and grenadine. Shake well. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.

instructions.zh: 除苏打水外，将所有原料与冰块一起摇匀。倒入玻璃杯中。上面加苏打水。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice cubes, except soda water. Pour into glass. Top with soda water.

instructions.zh: 准备杜松子柠檬酒时，您不需要摇酒器。将玻璃杯装满冰块，将杜松子酒和柠檬水倒在上面。轻轻混合并用一片柠檬装饰。喜欢的人还可以加几片薄荷叶。您的杜松子柠檬酒已准备好上桌。
instructions.en: For the preparation of the gin lemon you will not need the shaker. Fill the tumbler with ice, pour the gin and lemonade over it. Gently mix and decorate with a slice of lemon. Those who prefer can also add a few mint leaves. Your gin lemon is ready to be served.

instructions.zh: 将高脚玻璃杯装满一半冰块。将杜松子酒和石榴糖浆混合在一起，倒在冰上。加入酸橙汁或柠檬汁，最后加入苏打水。用酸橙和/或柠檬片装饰玻璃杯。
instructions.en: Half-fill a tall glass with ice. Mix the gin and Grenadine together and pour over the ice. Add the lime or lemon juice and top off with soda water. Decorate the glass with lime and/or lemon slices.

instructions.zh: 将糖粉溶解在水和柠檬汁的混合物中。添加杜松子酒。倒入装有冰块的老式玻璃杯中并搅拌。加入橙皮，即可食用。
instructions.en: Dissolve powdered sugar in mixture of water and juice of lemon. Add gin. Pour into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes and stir. Add the twist of orange peel and serve.

instructions.zh: 在老式玻璃杯中将糖与碳酸水和薄荷枝混合。添加杜松子酒和 1 个冰块。搅拌，加入橙片和樱桃，即可食用。
instructions.en: Muddle sugar with carbonated water and mint sprigs in an old-fashioned glass. Add gin and 1 ice cube. Stir, add the orange slice and the cherry, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，将杜松子酒、柠檬汁和糖混合。摇匀。滤入酸玻璃杯中，用橙片和樱桃装饰。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.

instructions.zh: 将杜松子酒、石榴糖浆和糖粉与冰搅拌，滤入盛有冰块的高球杯中。加入碳酸水并搅拌。用菠萝块和草莓装饰即可食用。
instructions.en: Stir gin, grenadine, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Decorate with the pineapple chunks and the strawberries and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，将酸橙汁、糖、杜松子酒和苦精混合。摇匀。冰块几乎装满了一个冷却杯。搅拌直至玻璃结霜。将摇酒器中的混合物滤入玻璃杯中，然后加入苏打水。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the lime juice, sugar, gin, and bitters. Shake well. Almost fill a colling glass with ice cubes. Stir until the glass is frosted. Strain the mixture in the shaker into the glass and add the club soda.

instructions.zh: 在老式玻璃杯中混合糖粉和水。添加杜松子酒和一块冰块。搅拌，加入柠檬皮，即可食用。
instructions.en: Mix powdered sugar and water in an old-fashioned glass. Add gin and one ice cube. Stir, add the twist of lemon peel, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在高球杯中加入冰块，倒入杜松子酒，倒入汤力水，挤入柠檬角，并用柠檬角装饰。
instructions.en: Fill a highball glass with ice, pour the gin, top with tonic water and squeeze a lemon wedge and garnish with a lemon wedge.

instructions.zh: 将糖和香料放入水中煮沸，在水中放置30分钟。过滤加香料的水并与酒混合。缓慢加热直至低于沸腾温度。 （要去除酒精，请煮沸一会儿。）您可以添加柠檬汁或橙汁调味。盛入爱尔兰咖啡杯中。
instructions.en: Boil sugar and spices in water, leave in the water for 30 minutes. Strain the spiced water and mix with the wine. Heat slowly until short of boiling temperature. (To remove alcohol, let it boil for a while.) You may add lemon or orange juice to taste. Serve in irish coffee cup.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料与碎冰充分摇匀，滤入香槟杯中即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a champagne flute, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料直接倒入装有冰块的老式玻璃杯中。轻轻搅拌。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.

instructions.zh: 将伏特加和苦杏酒倒入加冰的老式玻璃杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Pour vodka and amaretto into an old-fashioned glass over ice and serve.

instructions.zh: 用老式玻璃杯盛装。
instructions.en: Serve in an old fashioned glass.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，将杜松子酒、三秒酒、菠萝汁和石榴糖浆混合。摇匀。倒入老式玻璃杯中，用菠萝片装饰。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, triple sec, pineapple juice, and grenadine. Shake well. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the pineapple slice.

instructions.zh: 将原料倒入加冰的鸡尾酒调酒器中。快速摇匀，然后滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。
instructions.en: Pour ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake briskly and then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

instructions.zh:
将伏特加加入装满冰块的柯林斯杯中。
淋上葡萄柚汁并搅拌。
instructions.en:
Add the vodka to a Collins glass filled with ice.
Top with grapefruit juice and stir.

instructions.zh: 将咖啡豆和 151 在玻璃杯中混合。快速加冰，将石榴糖浆倒在冰上，呈现冰红色调。
instructions.en: Mix Kahlua and 151 in glass. Quickly add ice and pour grenadine over ice to give ice red tint.

instructions.zh: 将威士忌和百利甜酒放入啤酒杯（至少 50 厘升）中混合。将杯子的其余部分装满咖啡。
instructions.en: Mix the whisky and Baileys Cream in a beer-glass (at least 50 cl). Fill the rest of the glass with coffee.

instructions.zh:
将樱桃汁、橙皮、辣椒、肉桂棒、丁香和生姜倒入一个大平底锅中。煮5分钟，然后关火。待冷却，然后冷藏至少 4 小时，或最多 2 天 - 放置时间越长，味道越浓郁。如果给小孩子吃，几个小时后就把辣椒拿出来。

准备好食用时，将果汁倒入壶中。装在玻璃瓶或玻璃杯中，并在每个玻璃瓶或玻璃杯中插入一根吸管。如果您要添加伏特加，请在这个阶段添加。每个玻璃杯上都挂着一颗尖牙。
instructions.en:
Tip the cherry juice, orange peel, chilli, cinnamon sticks, cloves and ginger into a large saucepan. Simmer for 5 mins, then turn off the heat. Leave to cool, then chill for at least 4 hrs, or up to 2 days – the longer you leave it the more intense the flavours. If serving to young children, take the chilli out after a few hours.

When you’re ready to serve, pour the juice into a jug. Serve in glass bottles or glasses and pop a straw in each. If you're adding vodka, do so at this stage. Dangle a fangs sweet from each glass.

instructions.zh: 将摩根船长的香料朗姆酒倒入冰块中，倒入玻璃杯，倒入姜汁汽水。用石灰装饰。尝起来像奶油苏打水。以吉利根岛命名（《金杰》中的“船长”是一位快乐的船长！）
instructions.en: Pour Captain Morgan's Spiced Rum over ice, fill glass to top with Ginger Ale. Garnish with lime. Tastes like a cream soda. Named for the Gilligan's Island reference ("The Captain" *in* "Ginger" is a Happy Skipper!)

instructions.zh: 将伏特加和橙汁与冰块一起放入玻璃杯中搅拌，然后将加利亚诺浮在上面。装饰并上菜。
instructions.en: Stir the vodka and orange juice with ice in the glass, then float the Galliano on top. Garnish and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，混合所有成分。摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入加冰的摇酒壶中。摇。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake.

instructions.zh: 将 Hot Damn 100 倒入罐子或普通玻璃杯的底部。将剩下的杯子装满甜茶。用勺子、吸管或者更好的是肉桂棒搅拌，然后将其留在里面。
instructions.en: Pour Hot Damn 100 in bottom of a jar or regular glass. Fill the rest of the glass with sweet tea. Stir with spoon, straw, or better yet a cinnamon stick and leave it in.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（橄榄除外）与冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中。加入橄榄即可食用。
instructions.en: Stir all ingredients (except olive) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the olive and serve.

instructions.zh: 拿一堆葡萄汁和一堆碳酸饮料（苏打水、姜汁汽水、柠檬酸橙等等）。将它们混合在潘趣酒碗中。服用橙子果子露和酸橙果子露。舀出勺子，将它们漂浮在冲床中，让它们稍微融化，这样一层令人讨厌的薄膜就会遍布冲床的顶部，但其中仍然有果子露勺形式的“气泡”。看起来很可怕，味道却还不错。
instructions.en: Take a bunch of grape juice and a bunch of fizzy stuff (club soda, ginger ale, lemonlime, whatever). Mix them in a punch bowl. Take orange sherbet and lime sherbet. Scoop out scoops and float them in the punch, let them melt a little so that a nasty film spreads all over the top of the punch but there are still "bubbles" in it in the form of sherbet scoops. Looks horrible, tastes just fine.

instructions.zh: 将糖溶解在 2 杯沸水中，然后加入玉米糖浆。将速溶咖啡溶解在剩余的水中。将糖浆和咖啡倒入一加仑壶中。让它冷却。冷后加入伏特加和香草。为了获得最佳效果，让混合物“熟化”4-5 周。
instructions.en: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups of boiling water and add corn syrup. Dissolve the instant coffee in the remaining water. Pour syrup and coffee in a gallon jug. Let it cool. Add vodka and vanilla when cold. For the best result, let the mixture "mature" for 4-5 weeks.

instructions.zh: 将配料与碎冰一起摇匀
instructions.en: Shake ingredients with crushed ice

instructions.zh: 将白兰地和姜汁汽水直接倒入装有冰块的高球杯中。轻轻搅拌。用柠檬皮装饰。如果需要，可添加少许安古斯图拉苦酒。
instructions.en: Pour brandy and ginger ale directly into highball glass with ice cubes. Stir gently. Garnish with lemon zest. If desired, add dashes of Angostura Bitter.

instructions.zh: 将巧克力、黄油和香草放入双锅中融化。当奶油均匀搅拌时。
instructions.en: Melt the chocolate, butter and vanilla in a double boiler. When just smooth stir in the cream.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分混合在玻璃杯中
instructions.en: Combine all ingredients in glass

instructions.zh:
步骤1
将威士忌和蜂蜜搅拌在一起，然后分装在两个耐热玻璃杯中。每份加入一半肉桂棒，然后加入 200 毫升沸水。

步骤2
每份都加入一点柠檬汁，然后品尝并根据您的喜好添加更多。最后放上一片柠檬，并镶上丁香，然后立即食用。
instructions.en:
STEP 1
Whisk the whisky and honey together and split between 2 heatproof glasses. Add half of the cinnamon stick to each, then top up with 200ml boiling water.

STEP 2
Add a splash of lemon juice to each, then taste and add more to your preference. Finish each with a slice of lemon, studded with a clove, and serve immediately.

instructions.zh: 将孟买蓝宝石、白马提尼、糖浆和黑莓放入装有大量冰块的鸡尾酒调酒器中，剧烈摇晃，然后倒入气球玻璃杯中，加入柠檬水，并用一块橙子装饰。
instructions.en: Put the Bombay Sapphire, Martini Bianco, sugar syrup & blackberries in a cocktail shaker with lots of ice and shake vigorously before pouring into a balloon glass, topping up with lemonade and garnishing with a wedge of orange.

instructions.zh: 将伏特加放入装有冰茶的玻璃杯中。加入柠檬调味。
instructions.en: Put Vodka in glass fill with iced tea. Stir in lemon to taste.

instructions.zh: 混合直至咖啡和糖溶解。添加牛奶。摇匀。使用搅拌机或奶昔机可以制作出泡沫丰富的饮料。盛入咖啡杯中。
instructions.en: Mix together until coffee and sugar is dissolved. Add milk. Shake well. Using a blender or milk shake maker produces a very foamy drink. Serve in coffee mug.

instructions.zh: 在咖啡杯中混合在一起，并在食用前冷却。
instructions.en: Mix together in a coffee mug and chill before serving.

instructions.zh: 加冰摇匀，滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: Shake with ice and strain into cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（碳酸水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入盛有两块冰块的高球杯中。加入碳酸水，搅拌，即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将半个青柠切成片，放入摇酒壶中，加入糖并压碎。量取百香果汁，将其添加到摇酒壶中并装满冰块。关闭摇床并剧烈摇晃。将液体倒入玻璃杯中，加入姜汁汽水，用茶匙搅拌，然后用一片酸橙装饰玻璃杯边缘
instructions.en: Cut half a lime into pieces, place in a shaker, add the sugar and crush. Measure the passion fruit juice, add it to the shaker and fill up with ice cubes. Close the shaker and shake vigorously. Pour the liquid into a glass, top up with ginger ale, stir with a teaspoon and then garnish the rim of the glass with a slice of lime

instructions.zh: 加热咖啡、威士忌和糖；不要煮沸。倒入玻璃杯中，并在上面涂上奶油；趁热上桌。
instructions.en: Heat the coffee, whiskey and sugar; do not boil. Pour into glass and top with cream; serve hot.

instructions.zh: 将苏格兰威士忌和牛奶混合。加一半。添加休息。
instructions.en: Mix scotch and milk. Add half-and-half. Add rest.

instructions.zh: 将爱尔兰奶油、伏特加和波本威士忌倒入玻璃杯中。添加一些冰块并与橙汁混合。
instructions.en: Pour Irish Cream, Vodka, and Bourbon in a glass. Add some ice and mix in the orange juice.

instructions.zh: 按照食谱中列出的顺序添加成分。添加吉尼斯黑啤酒时必须小心，以防止产生过多的泡沫。不要加冰。
instructions.en: Add the ingredients in the order listed in the recipe. Care must be taken when adding the Guinness to prevent an excess of foam. Do Not add ice.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（橙片和樱桃除外）倒入装有冰块的柯林斯玻璃杯中。用橙片装饰，在上面添加樱桃，即可食用。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients (except orange slice and cherry) into a collins glass over ice cubes. Garnish with the slice of orange, add the cherry on top, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 倒入材料后，根据口味添加3-5块冰块。用搅拌器搅拌饮料，去除底部的香草味。
instructions.en: After pouring in your ingredients, and adding 3-5 ice cubes, according to taste. Stir the drink with a stirrer to get the Vanilla off the bottom.

instructions.zh: 加冰食用——警告，致命！
instructions.en: Serve over ice- Warning,Deadly!

instructions.zh: 在小玻璃杯的边缘涂上糖，然后用糖浆粘住。将香波覆盆子利口酒倒入玻璃杯中，小心地在上面铺上百利甜爱尔兰奶油。服务。
instructions.en: Coat the rim of a shot glass with sugar using sugar syrup to stick. Add the Chambord raspberry liqueur to the shot glass, and carefully layer the Baileys Irish Cream on top. Serve.

instructions.zh: 将玻璃杯装满冰块。添加一杯蒂亚玛丽亚和一杯牙买加淡朗姆酒。将玻璃杯装满牛奶。搅拌至光滑并立即食用。
instructions.en: Fill a tumbler with ice cubes. Add a shot of Tia Maria and a shot of Jamaican light rum. Fill the tumbler with milk. Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

instructions.zh: 将朗姆酒、咖啡和水搅拌在一起。上面放上生奶油。撒上少许磨碎的咖啡，然后用吸管饮用。
instructions.en: Stir the rum, coffee and water together. Top with the whipped cream. Sprinkle with a pinch of well ground coffee and drink with a straw.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（碳酸水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入盛有两块冰块的高球杯中。加入碳酸水，搅拌，即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

instructions.zh: 煮沸 3 杯水，然后加入果冻。将果冻和水混合直至果冻完全溶解。添加两杯伏特加并混合在一起。将混合物倒入塑料玻璃杯中并冷却直至变硬。然后，吃掉...
instructions.en: Boil 3 cups of water then add jello. Mix jello and water until jello is completely disolved. Add the two cups of vodka and mix together. Pour mixture into plastic shot glasses and chill until firm. Then, eat away...

instructions.zh: 在小马杯中混合等份，味道就像软糖一样！
instructions.en: mix equal parts in pony glass-tastes just like a jelly bean!

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的搅拌杯中，混合所有成分。搅拌均匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 弄湿玻璃杯，将边缘浸入糖中。然后加入冰块。然后添加其他所有内容。就这么简单！
instructions.en: Wet glass, dip rim in sugar. Then add Ice. Then add everything else. It's that simple!

instructions.zh: 将所有原料直接倒入装满冰块的高球杯中。轻轻搅拌。装饰。添加少许安古斯图拉苦精。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients directly into highball glass filled with ice. Stir gently. Garnish. Add a dash of Angostura bitters.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料放入搅拌杯中 - 盖上盖子并以中速搅拌直至充分混合。倒入 1 个高杯、2 个中杯或 3 个小杯，然后喝完。
instructions.en: Place all ingredients in the blender jar - cover and whiz on medium speed until well blended. Pour in one tall, 2 medium or 3 small glasses and drink up.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分与冰一起摇匀。滤入玻璃杯，装饰并上桌。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients together with ice. Strain into glass, garnish and serve.

instructions.zh: 将一枚铜币放入咖啡杯中，倒入咖啡直至看不到硬币，然后添加酒精直至看到硬币。挪威特产。
instructions.en: Put a copper coin in a coffe-cup and fill up with coffee until you no longer see the coin, then add alcohol until you see the coin. Norwegian speciality.

instructions.zh: 将波旁威士忌和本笃会倒入白兰地酒杯中。
instructions.en: Pour the bourbon and Benedictine into a brandy snifter.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，将库本和本笃会混合在一起。摇匀并滤入鸡尾酒杯。用柠檬片装饰。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes combine the courbon and Benedictine. Shake and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

instructions.zh: 将生姜和柠檬榨汁，加入热水中。您可以添加小豆蔻。
instructions.en: Juice ginger and lemon and add it to hot water. You may add cardomom.

instructions.zh: 搅拌。在上面添加生奶油。
instructions.en: Stir. Add whipped cream to the top.

instructions.zh: 将黑醋栗奶油加入杯底，然后倒入葡萄酒。
instructions.en: Add the crème de cassis to the bottom of the glass, then top up with wine.

instructions.zh: 将黑醋栗奶油倒入玻璃杯中，轻轻地在上面倒上香槟
instructions.en: Pour Creme de cassis in glass, gently pour champagne on top

instructions.zh: 在玻璃杯中混合
instructions.en: mix in the glass

instructions.zh: 在高球杯中混合。搅拌。用猕猴桃片装饰。
instructions.en: Mix in highball glass. Stirr. Garnish with slice of kiwi.

instructions.zh:
猕猴桃马提尼是一种非常有趣的伏特加鸡尾酒，也是利用新鲜水果的最佳饮料之一。尽管有一些食谱，但这是最简单的食谱之一，而且它是一种绝对令人愉悦的绿色马提尼酒。

对于这个食谱，您只需将猕猴桃片与简单的糖浆混合，然后与伏特加摇匀即可。这是一款任何人都可以在几分钟内调配出来的饮料，也是一款完美的鸡尾酒，可以展示您最喜欢的伏特加。
instructions.en:
The kiwi martini is a very fun vodka cocktail and it is one of the best drinks that makes use of fresh fruit. Though there are a few recipes floating around, this is one of the easiest and it is an absolutely delightful green martini to drink.

For this recipe, you'll simply muddle slices of kiwi with simple syrup, then shake it with vodka. It's a drink that anyone can mix up in minutes and a perfect cocktail to show off your favorite vodka.

instructions.zh: 将所有东西放入搅拌机中并液化。
instructions.en: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

instructions.zh: 将 Kool Aid 添加到双杯中，并在上面倒入朗姆酒。猛击并射击。
instructions.en: Add Kool Aid to a double shot glass, and top with rum. Slam and shoot.

instructions.zh: 倒入装有冰块的大玻璃杯中并搅拌。加入少许酸果蔓汁调味。
instructions.en: Pour into a large glass with ice and stir. Add a little cranberry juice to taste.

instructions.zh: 首先将酷爱饮料装满半个玻璃杯。然后将纸巾放在玻璃杯顶部，慢慢倒入伏特加。如果操作正确，您应该能够看到两种液体分开，伏特加在上面。现在猛击它！你最后尝到的是酷爱饮料。
instructions.en: Fill half the shot glass with the kool-aid first. Then put a paper towel over the top of the glass and slowly pour in the vodka. If you do it right, you should be able to see that the two liquids are separated, with the vodka on top. Now slam it! The last thing you'll taste is the kool-aid.

instructions.zh: 将 Absolut Kurant 倒入一个舒适的大茶杯中。添加不太热（！）的苹果茶，如果您愿意，可以添加一些糖。享受！
instructions.en: Pour Absolut Kurant into a comfortably big tea-cup. Add the not too hot(!) apple tea and, if you like, some sugar. Enjoy!

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（碳酸水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入盛有两块冰块的鸡尾酒杯中。加入碳酸水，搅拌，即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在搅拌机中搅拌 3 秒钟。 Lassi 是最容易制作的东西之一，而且制作方法有很多种。基本上，它是酪乳（加水搅拌的酸奶），您可以选择几乎任何您喜欢的稠度，从最稀到最稠。冷食。
instructions.en: Blend in a blender for 3 seconds. Lassi is one of the easiest things to make, and there are many ways of making it. Basically, it is buttermilk (yoghurt whisked with water), and you can choose almost any consistency that you like, from the thinnest to the thickest. Serve cold.

instructions.zh: 将它们全部放入搅拌机中并倒在碎冰上。您还可以使用其他水果，例如草莓和香蕉。
instructions.en: Put it all in a blender and pour over crushed ice. You can also use other fruits like strawberries and bananas.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分放入搅拌机中，搅拌直至细腻且起泡。冷藏后食用。
instructions.en: Put all ingredients into a blender and blend until nice and frothy. Serve chilled.

instructions.zh: 在搅拌机中搅拌（冰沙）直至起泡。加入撕碎的咖喱叶，冷食。
instructions.en: Blend (frappe) in blender until frothy. Add torn curry leaves and serve cold.

instructions.zh: 将酸奶和冰块混合在一起，直到酸奶变得更加流动。加糖调味。柠檬/酸橙是可选的，但它会给它带来轻微的酸味。少许盐。 Raita 也很适合夏天。您可以制作raita，而不是传统的沙拉。
instructions.en: Blend the yoghurt and ice cubes together, until the yoghurt becomes more liquid. Add sugar to taste. The lemon/lime is optional but it gives it a slightly tart taste. Dash of salt. Raita is also good for the summer. Instead of having a traditional salad you can make raita instead.

instructions.zh: 将椰子利口酒（最好是龙舌兰酒）与葡萄柚汁混合，然后加入苏打水。用一大片葡萄柚片装饰在玻璃杯内侧。
instructions.en: Mix the coconut liqueur (preferably tequila) with the grapefruit juice and top with soda water. Garnish with a large grapefruit slice against the inside of the glass.

instructions.zh: 摇匀并滤入镶有糖的冰镇鸡尾酒杯中。
instructions.en: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass rimmed with sugar.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒在冰上，搅拌并享用！
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients over ice, stir and enjoy!

instructions.zh: 将加利亚诺 (Galliano) 和绝对香橼 (Absolut Citron) 放入小酒杯中混合，将撒有糖的柠檬块放在玻璃杯上，然后将朗姆酒倒在柠檬块和玻璃杯上。用打火机点燃朗姆酒并燃烧一秒钟。一定要快速射击并吮吸柠檬。如果做得正确，尝起来就像一杯甜柠檬水。
instructions.en: Mix Galliano and Absolut Citron in a shot glass, lay lemon wedge sprinkled with sugar over glass and pour a rum over wedge and glass. light rum with a lighter and let burn for a second. Do shot quickly and suck on lemon. If it is done correctly, this will taste like a shot of sweet lemonade.

instructions.zh: 将柠檬榨汁。将生姜去皮并磨碎。将磨碎的生姜和适量的辣椒放入一块粗棉布中，然后打一个结。让我们浸泡在水中。大约15分钟后，加入糖和柠檬汁。冷静一下，然后上菜。
instructions.en: Juice the lemons. Peel and grate the ginger. Place the grated ginger and a liberal dash of the cayenne pepper into a piece of cheesecloth, and tie it into a knot. Let soak in the water. After 15 minutes or so, add the sugar, and the lemon juice. Chill, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在一个大玻璃杯中，放入酸橙汁和糖，搅拌均匀。添加冷苏打水以填充。将柠檬皮放入玻璃杯中。喝。重复此操作，直到酸橙或苏打水用完。
instructions.en: In a large glass, put the lime juice and sugar, and stir well. Add cold seltzer water to fill. Put the lime peels in the glass. Drink. Repeat until limes or soda run out.

instructions.zh: 打开电晕。用朗姆酒填充瓶颈处的空间。瓶子应装满至顶部。用拇指或手掌塞住瓶子。将瓶子倒置，让朗姆酒和啤酒混合。将瓶子正面朝上，拔掉插头，然后饮用。
instructions.en: Open the Corona. Fill the empty space in the neck in the bottle with the rum. The bottle should be filled to the top. Plug the bottle with your thumb or the palm of your hand. Turn the bottle upside-down so the rum and beer mix. Turn the bottle rightside-up, unplug, and drink.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的调酒杯中，将苏格兰威士忌、烈酒和苦艾酒混合。搅拌均匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。用柠檬片装饰。
instructions.en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch, Drambuie, and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的搅拌杯中，混合所有成分。搅拌均匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 加冰搅拌原料，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 搅拌糖粉和 2 盎司。柯林斯玻璃杯中的碳酸水。在玻璃杯中加入冰块，加入杜松子酒和苦艾酒，然后搅拌。加入碳酸水并再次搅拌。添加柠檬皮和橙色螺旋的扭曲，使末端悬挂在玻璃边缘上。
instructions.en: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice, add gin and vermouth, and stir. Fill with carbonated water and stir again. Add the twist of lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end dangles over rim of glass.

instructions.zh: 在高球杯中混合所有内容物并轻轻搅拌。添加少许可口可乐着色，并用柠檬或酸橙花装饰。
instructions.en: Mix all contents in a highball glass and sitr gently. Add dash of Coca-Cola for the coloring and garnish with lemon or lime twist.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分（可乐除外）混合，倒入高球杯中的冰块上。添加一点可乐来上色。用一片柠檬装饰即可食用。
instructions.en: Combine all ingredients (except cola) and pour over ice in a highball glass. Add the splash of cola for color. Decorate with a slice of lemon and serve.

instructions.zh: 用冰块和安古斯图拉摇匀高脚玻璃杯，使玻璃杯内部覆盖一层冰块。将伏特加倒在上面，加入 1 片酸橙，挤出剩余的汁液，与滋补品混合，搅拌，瞧，你就有了一杯长伏特加
instructions.en: Shake a tall glass with ice cubes and Angostura, coating the inside of the glass. Por the vodka onto this, add 1 slice of lime and squeeze juice out of remainder, mix with tonic, stir and voila you have a Long Vodka

instructions.zh: 将朗姆酒和蒂亚玛丽亚倒入几乎装满冰块的老式玻璃杯中。搅拌均匀。
instructions.en: Pour the rum and Tia Maria into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

instructions.zh: 将一品脱玻璃杯装满啤酒。然后将剩余的橙汁填满（注意不要填满）。然后喝一杯苦杏酒并把它放进去。
instructions.en: Fill a pint glass almost full with beer. Then fill the rest with orange juice (careful not to fill it to the top). Then take the shot of Amaretto and drop it in.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​。滤入玻璃杯中。用稻草装饰并食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice. Strain into glass. Garnish and serve with straw.

instructions.zh:
从 1½ 个酸橙中榨汁，与芒果混合，制成光滑的果泥。
将其余的酸橙切成四等份，然后将每个楔形物再次切成两半。每人在高球杯中放入 2 块酸橙，并在每杯中加入 1 茶匙细砂糖和 5-6 片薄荷叶。用搅拌器或擀面杖的末端将所有东西压碎，释放出酸橙和薄荷的所有味道。
将芒果泥分装在玻璃杯中，并在每个玻璃杯中加入 30 毫升白朗姆酒和一把碎冰，充分搅拌，将所有东西混合在一起。加满苏打水即可食用，如果您喜欢的话，可以用额外的薄荷装饰。
instructions.en:
Squeeze the juice from 1½ limes and blend with the mango to give a smooth purée.
Cut the rest of the limes into quarters, and then cut each wedge in half again. Put 2 pieces of lime in a highball glass for each person and add 1 teaspoon of caster sugar and 5-6 mint leaves to each glass. Squish everything together with a muddler or the end of a rolling pin to release all the flavours from the lime and mint.
Divide the mango purée between the glasses and add 30ml white rum and a handful of crushed ice to each one, stirring well to mix everything together. Top up with soda water to serve and garnish with extra mint, if you like.

instructions.zh: 加冰搅拌，滤入冰镇玻璃杯中，装饰后即可享用。
instructions.en: Stirred over ice, strained into a chilled glass, garnished, and served up.

instructions.zh: 用石灰片擦拭玻璃杯的边缘，使盐粘在玻璃杯上。注意仅润湿外缘并在其上撒盐。盐应该出现在饮用者的嘴唇上，并且不要混入鸡尾酒中。将其他成分与冰一起摇匀，然后小心地倒入玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: Rub the rim of the glass with the lime slice to make the salt stick to it. Take care to moisten only the outer rim and sprinkle the salt on it. The salt should present to the lips of the imbiber and never mix into the cocktail. Shake the other ingredients with ice, then carefully pour into the glass.

instructions.zh:
将所有成分添加到搅拌杯中并加满冰块。

搅拌直至冷却，然后滤入冷却的轿跑车玻璃杯中。
instructions.en:
Add all ingredients to a mixing glass and fill with ice.

Stir until chilled, and strain into a chilled coupe glass.

instructions.zh: 直接：将所有原料倒入装有冰块的混合杯中。搅拌均匀。滤入冰镇马提尼鸡尾酒杯。将柠檬皮中的油挤到饮料上，或用橄榄装饰。
instructions.en: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with olive.

instructions.zh: 摇匀并滤入冰镇的大鸡尾酒杯中
instructions.en: Shake and strain into a chilled large cocktail glass

instructions.zh: 将2杯水煮沸。添加所有成分并再次煮沸约15秒。让我们静置一分钟。将牛奶倒入锅中加热。将茶过滤到杯子中。添加牛奶和糖。就是这样。
instructions.en: Bring 2 cups of water to boil. Add all the ingredients and boil again for about 15 seconds. Let stand for a minute. Warm milk in a pot. Filter tea into cups. Add milk and sugar. That's IT.

instructions.zh:
1 - 倒入里卡德（或茴香酒）
2 - 倒入燕麦糖浆
3 - 最后倒入水并根据需要添加冰块。

最后加入冰块，否则糖浆和茴香酒混合不好。
instructions.en:
1 - Pour the Ricard (or pastis)
2 - Pour the orgeat syrup
3 - Finally pour the water and add ice cubes at your convenience.

Add the ice cubes at the end, otherwise the syrup and pastis do not mix well.

instructions.zh: 冲泡浓缩咖啡。在咖啡杯中放入一茶匙不加糖的可可粉，然后在一茶匙上涂上蜂蜜，淋入杯中。煮咖啡时搅拌，这是有趣的部分。可可似乎在没有混合的情况下覆盖了蜂蜜，所以你会得到一种布满灰尘的粘稠物质，看起来好像永远不会混合。然后突然间，急！它看起来像黑巧克力酱。将热浓缩咖啡倒在蜂蜜上，搅拌使其溶解。与奶油一起食用。
instructions.en: Brew espresso. In a coffee mug, place 1 teaspoon of unsweetened powdered cocoa, then cover a teaspoon with honey and drizzle it into the cup. Stir while the coffee brews, this is the fun part. The cocoa seems to coat the honey without mixing, so you get a dusty, sticky mass that looks as though it will never mix. Then all at once, presto! It looks like dark chocolate sauce. Pour hot espresso over the honey, stirring to dissolve. Serve with cream.

instructions.zh: 第一：将椰林飘香与 2.5 盎司混合。朗姆酒加冰（放在一边）。第二：将代基里酒与 2.5 盎司混合。朗姆酒加冰。第三：冷冻时，加入冰冻混合物，然后在玻璃杯中混合代基里酒（确保它们不会混合在一起）。
instructions.en: First: Mix pina colada with 2.5 oz. of rum with ice(set aside). Second: Mix daiquiri with 2.5 oz. of rum with ice. Third: While frozen, add pina colda mix then daiquiri mix in glass (Making sure they do not get mixed together).

instructions.zh:
将啤酒与番茄汁、鲜榨酸橙汁、伍斯特酱、照烧酱、酱油或辣酱混合。
装在冰镇的、镶有盐的玻璃杯中
instructions.en:
Mix the beer with tomato juice, freshly squeezed lime juice, and Worcestershire sauce, teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, or hot sauce.
Served In a chilled, salt-rimmed glass

instructions.zh: 如果有的话，在鸡尾酒（马提尼）杯中加入糖浆，然后浸入巧克力片或粉末中。将配料加入加冰的摇酒壶中。摇匀，然后滤入鸡尾酒杯。
instructions.en: If available, rim cocktail (Martini) glass with sugar syrup then dip into chocolate flakes or powder. Add ingredients into shaker with ice. Shake well then strain into cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 确保两种成分充分冷却，然后混合到玻璃杯中。冷食。
instructions.en: Ensure both ingredients are well chilled, then mix into the glass. Serve cold.

instructions.zh: 在高球杯中轻轻搅拌薄荷、糖和水。将碎冰倒入玻璃杯中，加入波本威士忌并充分搅拌，直至玻璃杯充分磨砂。用薄荷枝装饰。
instructions.en: In a highball glass gently muddle the mint, sugar and water. Fill the glass with cracked ice, add Bourbon and stir well until the glass is well frosted. Garnish with a mint sprig.

instructions.zh: 倒入 6 盎司。杯子或爱尔兰咖啡杯中的咖啡。加入古柯粉和香波堡，搅拌均匀，最后加入生奶油。
instructions.en: pour 6 oz. of coffee in a mug or Irish coffee cup. add coca mix and chambord, mix well and top off with whipped cream.

instructions.zh: 将薄荷叶与糖和酸橙汁搅匀。加入少许苏打水，并在玻璃杯中装满碎冰。倒入朗姆酒并在上面加入苏打水。用稻草装饰并食用。
instructions.en: Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime juice. Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with cracked ice. Pour the rum and top with soda water. Garnish and serve with straw.

instructions.zh: 将薄荷和柠檬汁放入玻璃杯中，用勺子将薄荷捣碎，加入冰块和朗姆酒，然后加入苏打水。在上面放上安古斯图拉。
instructions.en: Put mint with lemon juice in a glas, mash the mint with a spoon, ice, rum & fill up with club soda. Top it with Angostura.

instructions.zh: 在摇酒器中与冰块充分摇匀，滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中。
instructions.en: Shake well over ice cubes in a shaker, strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入几乎装满冰块的老式玻璃杯中。搅拌均匀。
instructions.en: Pour all of the ingredients into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

instructions.zh: 首先放苦艾酒，然后放龙舌兰酒，最后放格拉纳丁糖浆。
instructions.en: first you put rhe absinthe, then put tequila, then put the Granadine syrup.

instructions.zh: 将伏特加和姜汁啤酒放入装满冰块的高球杯中混合。添加酸橙汁。轻轻搅拌。装饰。
instructions.en: Combine vodka and ginger beer in a highball glass filled with ice. Add lime juice. Stir gently. Garnish.

instructions.zh: 将所有内容物添加到一个大壶或潘趣酒碗中。搅拌均匀！
instructions.en: Add all contents to a large jug or punch bowl. Stir well!

instructions.zh: 将 3 杯水、糖、丁香、肉桂棒和柠檬皮放入不锈钢锅中煮 10 分钟。将葡萄酒加热至“咖啡温度”（不要煮沸），然后添加白兰地。
instructions.en: Simmer 3 cups water with, sugar, cloves, cinnamon sticks, and lemon peel in a stainless steel pot for 10 minutes. Add wine heat to a "coffee temperature" (DO NOT BOIL) then add the brandy.

instructions.zh:
将玻璃杯装满冰块
倒入杜松子酒和青柠汁
在玻璃杯中倒入姜汁啤酒
用黄瓜和酸橙片装饰
instructions.en:
Fill glass with ice
Pour Gin and Lime Juice
Fill glass with Ginger Beer
Garnish with Cucumer and Lime slice

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入装有冰的摇瓶中。摇匀。加冰食用。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients into a shaker of ice. Shake well. Serve on the rocks.

instructions.zh: 倒入加冰的玻璃杯中搅拌，装饰即可食用。
instructions.en: Stir into glass over ice, garnish and serve.

instructions.zh: 盛入冰镇鸡尾酒杯中。边缘加柠檬和糖。搅拌并过滤。
instructions.en: Serve in a chilled cocktail glass. Lemon and sugar the rim. Stir and Strain.

instructions.zh: 将混合威士忌、柠檬汁和糖粉加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸杯中。将波尔多酒浮在上面。用半片柠檬和樱桃装饰即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake blended whiskey, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Float claret on top. Decorate with the half-slice of lemon and the cherry and serve.

instructions.zh: 在咖啡杯中与一点牛奶（1 盎司左右）混合。 Nuke 杯子约 30-50 秒。搅拌直至加热的可可溶解。将杯子装满牛奶。核弹 1-2 分钟，具体取决于瓦数和对烧焦口器的偏好。
instructions.en: Mix with a bit of milk (1 oz or so) in coffee mug. Nuke mug for about 30-50 seconds. Stir until the heated cocoa dissolves. Fill mug with milk. Nuke for 1-2 minutes, depending on wattage and preferences as to burnt mouth parts.

instructions.zh: 加冰食用
instructions.en: Serve over ice

instructions.zh:
只需将它们混合在一起即可。
它本来是一杯酒，但作为成人份量的加冰的饮料也很好。

尝起来像燕麦饼干。
instructions.en:
Just mix it all together.
It's meant to be a shot, but it works just fine as a proper adult-sized drink over lots of ice.

Tastes like an oatmeal cookie.

instructions.zh: 将一把薄荷、2 盎司白朗姆酒、1 盎司糖浆、1 盎司青柠汁和 2 滴安戈斯图拉苦酒加冰摇匀。双滤入玻璃杯中，并在上面加入 2 盎司普罗塞克。
instructions.en: Shake a handful of mint, 2oz white rum, 1oz of sugar syrup, 1oz lime juice and 2 dashes angostura bitters with ice. Double strain into a glass and top with 2oz of prosecco.

instructions.zh:
将方糖放入老式玻璃杯中，加入苦味剂，加入少许白开水。搅拌直至溶解。
将玻璃杯装满冰块，然后加入威士忌。

用橙花和鸡尾酒樱桃装饰。
instructions.en:
Place sugar cube in old fashioned glass and saturate with bitters, add a dash of plain water. Muddle until dissolved.
Fill the glass with ice cubes and add whiskey.

Garnish with orange twist, and a cocktail cherry.

instructions.zh: 冷却鸡尾酒杯。将配料添加到搅拌杯中，并装满 2/3 的冰块。搅拌约20秒。倒空鸡尾酒杯并滤入杯中。用柠檬皮装饰。
instructions.en: Chill cocktail glass. Add ingredients to a mixing glass, and fill 2/3 full with ice. Stir about 20 seconds. Empty cocktail glass and strain into the glass. Garnish with a twist of lemon peel.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分添加到玻璃杯中 - 倒入
instructions.en: Add all ingredients to tumbler-Pour as shot

instructions.zh: 将白兰地、杜松子酒和橙汁加冰摇匀，滤入装有冰块的高球杯中。倒入姜汁汽水，搅拌，即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake brandy, gin, and orange juice with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在搅拌机中混合酒类。添加半勺冰并混合。用橙色和樱桃旗装饰。太好了，它会在你嘴里融化！
instructions.en: Combine liquors in a blender. Add a half scoop of ice and blend. Garnish with an orange and cherry flag. So good it will melt in your mouth!!!

instructions.zh: 将烈酒添加到玻璃杯的底部，并与搅拌饮料均匀地添加到顶部。在玻璃杯内装饰橙片，并在上面放一些迷迭香。
instructions.en: Add the spirits to the bottom of the glass and top equally with the mixer drinks. Garnish with orange slices inside the glass as well as some rosemary on top.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分混合在中型平底锅中。小火搅拌直至巧克力融化。增加热量并煮沸，经常搅拌。从火上移开并搅拌直至起泡。重新加热并再次煮沸。从火上移开，搅拌直至起泡。再次重复加热和搅拌。丢弃橙皮。 （可以提前 2 小时准备。在室温下静置。食用前，将其煮沸，离火并搅拌直至起泡。）将热巧克力倒入咖啡杯中。做 2 份。
instructions.en: Combine all ingredients in heavy medium saucepan. Stir over low heat until chocolate melts. Increase heat and bring just to a boil, stirring often. Remove from heat and whisk untily frothy. Return to heat and bring to boil again. Remove from heat, whisk until frothy. Repeat heating and whisking once again. Discard orange peel. (Can be prepared 2 hours ahead. Let stand at room temperature. Before serving, bring just to boil, remove from heat and whisk until frothy.) Pour hot chocolate into coffee mugs. Makes 2 servings.

instructions.zh: 将原料倒在冰上并搅拌。
instructions.en: Pour ingredients over ice and stir.

instructions.zh: 将一些冰块放入大玻璃杯或高球杯中，加入柠檬汁、橙汁、糖浆，搅拌均匀。加满冷苏打水，用吸管饮用。
instructions.en: Place some ice cubes in a large tumbler or highball glass, add lemon juice, orange juice, sugar syrup, and stir well. Top up with cold soda water, serve with a drinking straw.

instructions.zh: 在搅拌机中将伏特加、甘露酒、百利甜酒、冰淇淋和奥利奥充分混合。倒入一个大磨砂玻璃杯中。用生奶油和樱桃装饰。
instructions.en: Blend Vodka, Kahlua, Bailey's, ice-cream and the Oreo well in a blender. Pour into a large frosted glass. Garnish with whipped cream and a cherry.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 添加成分并在搅拌机中混合。
instructions.en: Add ingredients and mix in blender.

instructions.zh: 搅拌在一起并加冰食用。
instructions.en: Stir together and serve over ice.

instructions.zh: 在冰上一起摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯并冷藏后享用。
instructions.en: Shake together over ice. Strain into cocktail glass and serve chilled.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分倒入玻璃杯中并搅拌。用半片百香果装饰。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients into a glass and stir. Garnish with half a passion fruit piece.

instructions.zh: 摇匀，过滤，向上，鸡尾酒杯
instructions.en: Shake, strain, up, cocktail glass

instructions.zh: 将混合苏格兰威士忌、柠檬汁、蜂蜜糖浆和姜糖浆加冰摇匀。将大块冰滤入冰镇的岩石玻璃杯中。将烟熏苏格兰威士忌放在上面（一定要使用烟熏苏格兰威士忌，例如艾雷岛单一麦芽威士忌）。用蜜饯姜装饰。
instructions.en: Shake blended Scotch, lemon juice, honey syrup and ginger syrup with ice. Strain over large ice in chilled rocks glass. Float smoky Scotch on top (be sure to use a smoky Scotch such as an Islay single malt). Garnish with candied ginger.

instructions.zh: 在搅拌机中与碎冰混合直至光滑。倒入冰镇的玻璃杯中，装饰即可享用。
instructions.en: Mix with crushed ice in blender until smooth. Pour into chilled glass, garnish and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有东西放入搅拌机中并液化。
instructions.en: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.

instructions.zh:
用石灰片擦拭每个玻璃杯的边缘，然后浸入盐中。
添加冰块、龙舌兰酒、葡萄柚汁、酸橙汁，最后加入菠萝苏打水。
快速搅拌一下。
用新鲜菠萝或酸橙装饰。
instructions.en:
Rub the rim of each glass with lime slice and dip into salt.
Add ice, tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and top with pineapple soda.
Give it a quick stir.
Garnish with fresh pineapple or lime.

instructions.zh: 将苦味酒倒入酒杯中。旋转玻璃杯，使内部充满苦味剂，抖出多余的苦味剂。将杜松子酒倒入玻璃杯中。不要加冰。
instructions.en: Pour the bitters into a wine glass. Swirl the glass to coat the inside with the bitters, shake out the excess. Pour the gin into the glass. Do not add ice.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在加冰的摇酒器中慢慢摇匀，滤入方形威士忌杯中。上面放上新鲜的冰块。加入黑莓装饰。添加花朵和绿叶以获得特别的外观！
instructions.en: Slowly shake in a shaker with ice, strain into a square whiskey glass. Top with fresh ice. Add the blackberries to garnish. Add flowers and a green leaf for a special look!

instructions.zh: 摇匀
instructions.en: Shake well

instructions.zh: 将所有成分混合到碗中，保持冰镇，经常搅拌
instructions.en: mix all ingredients into bowl keep iced stir frequently

instructions.zh: 用冰块在鸡尾酒调酒器中剧烈摇晃并过滤内容物，然后倒入玻璃杯中，并用苦味剂装饰。
instructions.en: Vigorously shake and strain contents in a cocktail shaker with ice cubes, then pour into glass and garnish with bitters.

instructions.zh: 将除苦味剂外的所有原料倒入装有冰块的摇酒壶中。摇匀。倒入装满冰块的大玻璃杯中。添加安古斯图拉苦味酒，“在上面”。用鸡尾酒樱桃和菠萝装饰。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients, except the bitters, into shaker filled with ice. Shake well. Pour into large glass, filled with ice. Add Angostura bitters, "on top". Garnish with cocktail cherry and pineapple.

instructions.zh: 挤压橙子并滤出汁液。将所有原料放入装满冰块的摇酒壶中，摇晃至少 12 秒。滤入高球杯中，用菠萝块或您选择的水果装饰。
instructions.en: Squeeze an orange and strain the juice. Put all the ingredients in a shaker filled with ice and shake for at least 12 seconds. Strain into a highball glass and decorate with a pineapple wedge or fruit of your choice.

instructions.zh: 在高脚玻璃杯中加冰块，配上爆裂的樱桃（如果心情好的话，可以添加更多爆裂的樱桃）！
instructions.en: Served over ice in a tall glass with a popped cherry (can add more popped cherries if in the mood)!

instructions.zh: 加冰摇匀原料，滤入鸡尾酒杯即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 直接：将所有原料倒入装有冰块的混合杯中。摇匀。滤入冰镇马提尼鸡尾酒杯。将百香果切成两半并用作装饰。将普罗塞克倒入冰镇的玻璃杯中，与马提尼一起享用。
instructions.en: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Cut passion fruit in half and use as garnish. Pour prosecco into a chilled shot glass and serve alongside the martini.

instructions.zh: 小心地倒入咖啡杯中，使薄荷糖浮在石榴糖浆上。无需混合即可食用。
instructions.en: Pour carefully into a pousse-cafe glass, so that creme de menthe floats on grenadine. Serve without mixing.

instructions.zh: 加冰搅拌原料，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（肉豆蔻除外）加冰摇匀，滤入威士忌酸酒杯中。在上面撒上肉豆蔻即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

instructions.zh: 在搅拌机中加冰将配料摇匀。滤入玻璃杯，装饰并上桌。
instructions.en: Shake ingredients together in a mixer with ice. Strain into glass, garnish and serve.

instructions.zh: 用鸡尾酒搅拌器混合所有成分，并与碎冰、薄荷和食用面粉（如果有）一起食用。
instructions.en: Mix up all ingredients with a cocktail stirrer and serve with crushed ice with mint and edible flour if available.

instructions.zh: 加冰摇匀。
instructions.en: Shake with ice.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰摇匀​​，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将红酒和石榴糖浆倒入装有冰块的柯林斯杯中。倒入柠檬苏打水，搅拌即可食用。
instructions.en: Pour red wine and grenadine into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with lemon-lime soda, stir, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料加冰搅拌，滤入鸡尾酒杯中即可享用。
instructions.en: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，将朗姆酒、甘露酒和奶油混合。摇匀。滤入鸡尾酒杯并用肉豆蔻装饰。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, Kahlua, and cream. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the nutmeg.

instructions.zh: 首先在小玻璃杯中添加 1/3 Kahlua。然后是 1/3 Miduri，最后是 1/3 贝利爱尔兰奶油
instructions.en: In a shot glass add 1/3 Kahlua first. Then 1/3 Miduri, topping it off with a 1/3 bailey's irish cream

instructions.zh: 只需添加橙汁，快速倒入即可将桑布卡与橙汁混合。果汁一定要有果肉！
instructions.en: Simply add the orange juice, quite a quick pour in order to mix the sambucca with the orange juice. The juice MUST have fruit pulp!

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入一个非常高的玻璃杯中，加冰。小心地啜饮。
instructions.en: Pour all ingredients over ice in a very tall glass. Sip cautiously.

instructions.zh: 将啤酒倒入大杯中，慢慢加入 7-up（或雪碧）。
instructions.en: Pour beer into large mug, slowly add the 7-up (or Sprite).

instructions.zh: 在高玻璃杯中将糖浆与柠檬汁混合。加满姜汁汽水。
instructions.en: Mix sugar syrup with lemon juice in a tall glass. Fill up with ginger ale.

instructions.zh:
准备好柜台上的所有原料，以便能够快速有效地工作，尤其是奶油和蛋白。

将所有成分倒入摇酒壶中。

用力摇晃1分钟：奶油和蛋白必须完美混合，所以不要着急。

现在打开摇酒器，加入一些冰块，摇晃 1-2 分钟。就看你能抵抗多久了！

倒入高球杯中，加入少许苏打水并装饰以调味。

拉莫斯杜松子酒曾经被作为提神饮料，甚至作为早餐饮用，尝试将其作为开胃酒，晚餐后，您会发现现在失去了一点宝石。
instructions.en:
Prepare all the ingredients on the counter to be able to work well and quickly, especially the cream and egg white.

Pour all the ingredients into a shaker.

Shake vigorously for 1 minute: cream and egg white must be mixed perfectly, so don't rush.

Now open the shaker and put some ice and shake for 1-2 minutes. It depends on how long you can resist!

Pour into a highball glass, add a splash of soda and garnish to taste.

Ramos Gin Fizz was once drunk as an invigorating drink or even as a breakfast, try it as an aperitif and after dinner and you will discover a little gem now lost.

instructions.zh: 将覆盆子伏特加和苏打水倒入几乎装满冰块的高球杯中。搅拌均匀。
instructions.en: Pour the raspberry vodka and soda into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

instructions.zh: 将薄荷叶和覆盆子糖浆放在杯底轻轻搅匀。将碎冰和波本威士忌加入杯中，然后搅拌。上面加更多的冰块，用薄荷枝装饰。
instructions.en: Softly muddle the mint leaves and raspberry syrup in the bottom of the cup. Add crushed ice and Bourbon to the cup and then stir. Top with more ice, garnish with a mint sprig.

instructions.zh: 每人一枪，摇晃射击
instructions.en: One shot each, shake n shoot

instructions.zh: 在鸡尾酒调酒器中一起摇匀，然后滤入冰镇的玻璃杯中。装饰并上菜。
instructions.en: Shake together in a cocktail shaker, then strain into chilled glass. Garnish and serve.

instructions.zh:
1) 将孟买蓝宝石、蓝柑橘、迷迭香小枝和轻轻挤压的柠檬片放入气球玻璃杯中。充分旋转以混合。
2) 倒入冰块，然后加入发烧树淡汤力水。
3）用吧勺轻轻拌匀。
instructions.en:
1) Add the Bombay Sapphire, Blue Curacao, rosemary sprig and gently squeezed lemon wedge to a balloon glass. Swirl well to combine.
2) Fill with cubed ice and top with the Fever-Tree Light Tonic Water.
3) Gently fold with a bar spoon to mix.

instructions.zh: 将皇冠放在玻璃杯中，放在弗兰吉利科顶部。
instructions.en: Into a shot glass layer the Crown Royal on top of the Frangelico.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（可乐除外）加冰摇匀，滤入冰镇的柯林斯玻璃杯中。装满可乐即可上桌。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except cola) with ice and strain into a chilled collins glass. Fill with cola and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料倒入玻璃杯中，加冰。滤入玻璃杯中。
instructions.en: Pour all the ingredients into tumbler over ice. Strain into glass.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料（碳酸水除外）加冰摇匀，滤入盛有两块冰块的高球杯中。加入碳酸水，搅拌，即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将杜松子酒和蔓越莓倒入装满冰块的高球威士忌中。加入石榴糖浆并搅拌。
instructions.en: Pour gin and cranberry into a highball filled with ice cubes. Add grenadine and stir.

instructions.zh: 在老式玻璃杯中，将糖溶解在苏打水中。添加碎冰，直到玻璃杯几乎满为止。添加朗姆酒。搅拌均匀。用樱桃、橙子和柠檬片装饰。
instructions.en: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in the club soda. Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full. Add the rum. Stir well. Garnish with the cherry and the orange and lemon slices.

instructions.zh: 将朗姆酒和苏打水倒入几乎装满冰块的柯林斯玻璃杯中。搅拌均匀并用柠檬角装饰。
instructions.en: Pour the rum and soda into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well and garnish with the lemon wedge.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分（肉豆蔻除外）加冰摇匀，滤入柯林斯杯中。在上面撒上肉豆蔻即可食用。
instructions.en: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a collins glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

instructions.zh: 在老式玻璃杯中搅拌糖粉、水和苦精。当糖溶解后，加入冰块和淡朗姆酒。加入酸橙皮，将 151 度朗姆酒漂浮在上面，即可享用。
instructions.en: Stir powdered sugar, water, and bitters in an old-fashioned glass. When sugar has dissolved add ice cubes and light rum. Add the twist of lime peel, float 151 proof rum on top, and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有原料混合在潘趣酒碗中即可食用。
instructions.en: Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl and serve.

instructions.zh: 将所有成分混合在玻璃杯中并加冰。
instructions.en: Mix all ingredients in glass & add ice.

instructions.zh: 将朗姆酒倒入加冰块的高球杯中。加入橙汁，搅拌，即可食用。
instructions.en: Pour rum into a highball glass over ice cubes. Add orange juice, stir, and serve.

instructions.zh: 在装有半杯冰块的摇酒壶中，将朗姆酒、柠檬汁和糖混合。摇匀。滤入酸玻璃杯中，用橙片和樱桃装饰。
instructions.en: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.
